title: Renewal Loyalty Credit Amount on Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Booking.** When a business accepts the renewal offer of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement on or before its contract end date, the renewal loyalty credit is booked with the acceptance as one renewal loyalty credit line, a negative amount on the bill of the first cycle of the new term.

**Base credit.** The base credit is the renewal loyalty credit of the plan in force on the acceptance date, as the renewal schedule lists it for that plan. On the acceptance date the plan in force is the plan on the agreement record for the term that is expiring.

**Amount.** The renewal loyalty credit starts from the base credit and is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Which plan's credit is the base

| Plan in force on the acceptance date | Plan offered for the new term | Base credit |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | The Fixed 12 plan's renewal loyalty credit |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | The Fixed 36 plan's renewal loyalty credit |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | The Carbon Neutral 24 plan's renewal loyalty credit |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A Fixed 12 agreement with a contract end date of 2025-12-31 accepts, on 2025-12-10, an offer to renew onto the Fixed 24 plan. The plan in force on 2025-12-10 is the Fixed 12 plan, whose renewal loyalty credit in the renewal schedule is $50.00. The renewal loyalty credit is therefore $50.00, booked as a renewal loyalty credit line of minus $50.00 on the bill of the first cycle of the new term.
